newsitem.title: USA: Long way to go before enacting bank reform - Rubin.
newsitem.headline: Long way to go before enacting bank reform - Rubin.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said on Saturday that Congress has a long way to go before approving an overhaul of America's outdated banking laws and suggested that passage may not come until next year.
"We've got a lot to do on this," Rubin told reporters here for the annual summit of industrial nations. "banking bills, as you know, are always very difficutl to get."

Congress on Friday moved one step closer to tearing down the Depression-era barriers separating banking from other financial services, as the House Banking Committee narrowly approved a comprehensive reform bill.
